info.title: aidesk API
info.description: REST API of aidesk. Every route is generated from one route table; the access of a route names the action that has to be granted for the project concerned. Agents read the guide at /api/v1/guide.md first.

reason.description: Why the file is not read; present when readable is false. extraction_pending: the file is being read by the worker, ask again in a moment. image_reading_off: an image or a scan, and the project has not switched on the task image.read

failure.description: With extraction_failed: what the reader found out about the file, or how the run of the model ended (ai_*). An ai_* failure is of the moment: ask again after a few minutes

text.description: The content as text; present when readable is true

extraction.description: Present when the text was extracted from a PDF or Office file, or read by a model from an image or a scan (method ai:<model>, which can misread)

hidden.description: Parts of the document that a reader does not see and that were left out

get.summary: The profile of every task that asks a model (reply.draft, note.draft, image.read): connection, model, limits and whether it is on, with the version to name in a write. A task without a profile has version 0

dailyTokenBudget.description: Tokens per day, over input and output

enabled.description: When true, ticket content is sent to the provider of the connection

put.summary: Set the profile of a task. A profile is off unless enabled is true, and a profile that is on sends ticket content to the provider of its connection, so switching one on, or pointing one that is on at another connection, is applied only by a person with config.approve (200); anyone else, an agent under any policy, gets a proposal (202). Other changes follow the approval policy
